verbatim_quote: One-hundred-forty-three individuals (40 AD, 35 MCI, 28 PD and 40 HC) were recruited for this study from the Rehabilitative Neurology Unit at the Don Carlo Gnocchi Foundation in Milano (Italy).

For this study, we obtained plasma samples from 83 healthy cognitive controls (NC, ADNI 2), 87 AD (77 ADNI 2 + 10 OADRC), 100 PD (VHA), and 20 DLB (VHA), n = 290 total. [...] Of the total 290 samples, one NC male plasma sample had considerable hemolysis (very pink plasma) and was excluded from analysis.
